insufficient_funds.notes: Cash-flow timing. Align retry to likely payday. Do not spam.

expired_card.notes: Stale instrument. Nudge to update, then retry once.

issuer_risk.notes: Generic issuer decline. Try backup method / alt gateway.

card_not_supported.notes: Route to UPI / netbanking / backup card.

fraud_suspected.notes: Never auto-retry. Escalate to human queue.

gateway_timeout.notes: Network/gateway issue. Immediate retry on a different gateway.

checkout_abandoned.notes: Recover the session, do not charge blindly.

invoice_overdue.notes: B2B receivables: reminder → firm → PTP → escalate.

mandate_window_miss.notes: NACH/UPI autopay: retry only inside the allowed debit window.

silent_debtor.notes: Voice recovery in Hinglish after digital channels stall.
